text: the only other one i want to add and i dont think any one is going to speak up about it without me nudging them but could you actually see what the fuck u were doing because when the car is all one tan color i know i cant see jack shit. and thats not saying we need to color it piece by piece but the same model is legible in blender and you know it would be so what the fuck is up with the stage here for the model being worked on. if it were not for being able to see verts edges and faces as an overlay on the model u would never know its not just a cube
resolution: Quantified the model stage's inability to convey form and added it as P1-0 in the work order, listed first because it is why the other defects went unnoticed. 75 percent of the car body renders inside a 1.3/255 luminance band, and no ambient occlusion, cavity or matcap term exists anywhere in framework/gpu, so every recess, opening and panel break is invisible without the vertex/edge overlay.
